item.title: Electronic structure and optical properties of antiferromagnetic $3d$-oxides from a Wannier-localized optimally tuned screened range-separated hybrid functional
item.description:
The authors assess the performance of the recently developed non-empirical Wannier-localized, optimally tuned, screened range-separated hybrid (WOT-SRSH) functional for prototypical antiferromagnetic insulators: MnO, NiO, hematite, and chromia. By comparing WOT-SRSH with established hybrid functionals, self-consistent quasiparticle GW, dynamical mean-field theory, and available experimental data, they demonstrate its ability to offer quantitative improvement in the description of fundamental band gaps, spin magnetic moments, photoemission, and optical spectra. These results establish WOT-SRSH as a promising framework for predictive studies of the electronic, magnetic, and optical properties of magnetic insulators. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 103804] Published Fri Oct 16, 2026

Alexander B. Shick, Guy Ohad, Jeffrey B. Neaton, Leeor Kronik
